uncited: Leaf Collection identifies and gathers all terminal nodes (leaves) intersected by a ray grid during hierarchical traversal, converting a sparse traversal path into a contiguous list of active volumetric blocks for subsequent ray marching or shading.
It separates node identification from radiance computation to enable efficient memory compaction and parallel processing.
